name: Moonveil Stalker Fen
introDiscord: Moonlit mist clings to a submerged fen where black water hides tangled roots. Something moves whenever the fog thickens—and stops whenever you look directly at it.
introTwitch: Moonlit mist clings to a submerged fen where black water hides tangled roots. Something moves whenever the fog thickens—and stops whenever you look directly at it.

mistroot-verge.prompt: Mistroot tangles divide three trails. Each disappears into silver haze, and fresh footprints lead down all three despite nobody being visible.

left.message: Two pale eyes appear inside the fog. They vanish. A branch moves behind you. When the eyes return, the Moonveil Stalker is much closer.

right.message: A moon-shell coffer rests beneath reeds surrounded by tracks that deliberately circle it. You recover Star Candies while trying not to wonder what was watching the cache.

forward.message: Shizuki's Veilmoss cordial reads: "For cuts acquired while becoming untraceable. Also useful when the thing tracing you has claws."
forward.fullHpMessage: The Veilmoss cordial remains stoppered. You are already at full health, though the tracks around the shelter are less reassuring.

shrouded-mere.prompt: A starless mere reflects nothing—not the sky, not the reeds, not you. Three channels slip beneath leaning roots while ripples appear without visible cause.

left.message: A Fae vessel hangs from a root above the black water. Something beneath the surface circles while you retrieve Star Candies.

right.message: Beneath a weathered page, Shizuki left one Berry and a much newer note: "I used to think every shadow behind me was one of them. This one actually was. Run."

forward.message: The water ahead remains perfectly still. Your reflection appears anyway. Then it smiles before you do. A Moonveil Stalker rises behind it.

veilwater-crossing.prompt: Old warning stones emerge from the mist. Every inscription says some variation of 'do not follow the lights.' Naturally, three faint lights now mark three different routes.

left.message: Shizuki's restorative reads: "Drink in shadow. Smile when the hunters pass. Confuses them? No. Makes me feel better? Yes."
left.fullHpMessage: Shizuki's shadow-side restorative remains unused. At full health, you can save the intimidating smile for the next hunter.

right.message: A shadow slips behind one warning stone. Then another. By the third stone, the Stalker stops pretending you haven't noticed.

forward.message: A Moonkeeper cache has been hidden beneath one of the warning stones. Inside are Star Candies and a carved message: "IF YOU CAN READ THIS, YOU IGNORED THE WARNING."

boss-antechamber.name: Primeval Fenheart
boss-antechamber.prompt: The drowned roots knot around a black pool at the fen's center. Mist hangs motionless over the water, and every trail behind you has vanished.

bossPromptDiscord:
The fog stops moving.

No ripples cross the fen.

Every distant Stalker vanishes at once.

Then something much larger exhales inside the mist.

Use /yes to enter the Fenheart or /no to retreat while you still know which direction is out.
bossPromptTwitch:
The fog stops moving.

No ripples cross the fen.

Every distant Stalker vanishes at once.

Then something much larger exhales inside the mist.

Use !yes to enter the Fenheart or !no to retreat while you still know which direction is out.
bossRetreatText: You retreat from the Fenheart before the larger shape reaches the edge of the fog. The mist closes behind you without a sound.

boss.revealText: The fog tears open as a massive clawed silhouette emerges from the drowned roots. Veilclaw Prime has been stalking you the entire way.

completionText: Veilclaw Prime disappears back into the deepest mist. Slowly, ordinary sounds return to the fen. A path clears between the roots. You still feel watched, but at least now that seems normal.
